title: KazRNA-Pipe: a reproducible Nextflow workflow for integrated bulk and single-cell transcriptomic profiling
description: A containerised Nextflow workflow combining three-way bulk RNA-seq quantification (STAR, HISAT2, Salmon), three-way differential expression (DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom), CPU and GPU single-cell processing paths, and cross-method cell-type deconvolution. Includes per-run provenance capture, pinned container digests, and continuous end-to-end testing on a synthetic fixture.
